name: Vibe-Trading
readme_summary: Vibe-Trading is a Python-based personal trading agent that empowers users with comprehensive trading capabilities. It leverages multi-agent systems, AI, and LLMs to facilitate algorithmic trading, backtesting, and market analysis through a FastAPI backend and React frontend.
primary_use_case: To provide a comprehensive and intelligent platform for individuals to engage in algorithmic trading, backtesting, and market analysis through a personal trading agent.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, anthropomorphic owl wearing a sophisticated waistcoat, perched on a stack of glowing financial data charts. The owl is holding a magnifying glass to examine a complex trading strategy visualized as a winding, intricate maze. To its left, a stream of digital data particles flows into a 'Vibe-Trading' portal, and to its right, the maze transforms into clear, actionable trading signals represented by directional arrows and profit graphs. The background is a softly lit, futuristic trading floor with subtle UI elements and code snippets visible on floating screens. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, professional aesthetic and a color palette of deep blues, greens, and gold, emphasizing intelligence and precision.

name: claude-ads
description: Claude-first paid-media operations skill for Claude Code across 12 ad platforms (Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, X): source-grounded audits, deterministic scoring, versioned JSON reports, and capability-gated account changes.
readme_summary: Claude Ads is a Python-based, Claude-first paid-media operations tool designed to automate and audit advertising campaigns across 12 major platforms. It provides source-grounded audits, deterministic scoring, versioned reports, and capability-gated account changes, prioritizing safety and control.
key_features: Source-grounded audits with dated evidence and explicit confidence
Campaign planning for channels, budgets, measurement, and experiments
Creative asset generation briefs (copy, image, video)
Performance monitoring (pacing, delivery, tracking, fatigue, policy)
Versioned JSON reports with Markdown, HTML, and PDF rendering
Drafting safe account changes with multi-stage approval gates
Reporting on data discrepancies, stale sources, and failures
Support for 12 ad platforms including Google, Meta, Amazon, and X
primary_use_case: Automating and auditing paid-media operations across multiple advertising platforms with a focus on safety, control, and data integrity.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled conductor leading a grand orchestra, where each musician represents a different advertising platform (Google, Meta, Amazon, etc.). The conductor, holding a 'Claude Ads' baton, orchestrates complex melodies of data and strategy, transforming scattered musical notes (raw ad data) into a harmonious symphony (optimized ad campaigns and reports). Visual cues include glowing data streams flowing from platform icons to the conductor and then to a beautifully rendered score (versioned reports). The scene is a vibrant, modern concert hall with subtle digital overlays and a clean, professional aesthetic, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style.

name: web-check
description: 🕵️‍♂️ All-in-one OSINT tool for analysing any website
readme_summary: Web-Check is a comprehensive OSINT tool written in TypeScript that analyzes websites to provide detailed insights into their security, technology stack, and performance. It helps users understand, optimize, and secure their web presence by uncovering potential attack vectors, server configurations, and associated hostnames.
primary_use_case: Website analysis for open-source intelligence (OSINT), security assessment, and performance optimization.
cover_image_prompt: A curious detective wearing a magnifying glass as a monocle, examining a vibrant, intricate digital tapestry representing a website. The tapestry reveals glowing threads of data, showing its underlying code, security protocols (like a shield icon), and performance metrics (like a speed gauge). Small, subtle UI elements from the Web-Check dashboard float around the detective, displaying DNS records and SSL certificates. The background is a softly lit, modern office with a large monitor displaying the website's structure. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, professional aesthetic and a color palette of blues, greens, and purples, emphasizing clarity and insight.

name: Neoflow
description: Neoflow is an open-source whiteboard application designed for seamless collaboration and creativity. It combines simplicity with advanced features, making it perfect for teams, designers, and creative minds.
readme_summary: Neoflow is an open-source, real-time collaborative whiteboard application built on the tldraw engine and powered by Next.js. It offers a user-friendly interface with AI integration to enhance creative workflows for teams and individuals.
primary_use_case: Real-time collaborative brainstorming and design on a digital whiteboard.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, bustling digital canvas where diverse individuals, represented by glowing avatars, are simultaneously drawing, writing, and placing sticky notes. In the center, a subtle AI assistant icon hovers, intelligently organizing ideas into connected thought bubbles and suggesting visual links. The canvas itself is a metaphor for a shared mind, with ideas flowing seamlessly between participants. Small, unobtrusive UI elements from Neoflow are visible at the edges, hinting at the underlying technology. The scene is rendered in a bright, optimistic 3D isometric illustration style, emphasizing connection and creativity.
